00048 BEQBaseUGenInternal::BEQBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq, UGen const& control, UGen const& gain, const bool faster) throw()
00049 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00050     y1(0.f), y2(0.f), a0(0.f), a1(0.f), a2(0.f), b1(0.f), b2(0.f),
00051     currentFreq(0.f), currentControl(0.f), currentGain(0.f),
00052     faster_(faster)
00053 {
00054     inputs[Input] = input;
00055     inputs[Freq] = freq;
00056     inputs[Control] = control;
00057     inputs[Gain] = gain;

00060 void BEQBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00061 {
00062     int filterLoops = UGen::getFilterLoops();
00063     int filterRemain = UGen::getFilterRemain();
00064     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00065     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00066     float newFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00067     float newControl = *(inputs[Control].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00068     float newGain = *(inputs[Gain].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00069     float y0;
00070     
00071     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y1);
00072     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y2);
00073     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, a0);
00074     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, a1);
00075     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, a2);
00076     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, b1);
00077     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, b2);
00078     
00079     if((currentFreq != newFreq) || (currentControl != newControl) || (currentGain != newGain))
00080     {       
00081         double oneOverFilterLoops = 1.0 / (double)filterLoops;
00082         
00083         if(faster_ == true) // faster but glitches during large, rapid changes
00084         {
00085             double next_a0, next_a1, next_a2, next_b1, next_b2;
00086             calculateCoeffs(newFreq, newControl, newGain, next_a0, next_a1, next_a2, next_b1, next_b2);
00087                         
00088             double a0_slope = (next_a0 - a0) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00089             double a1_slope = (next_a1 - a1) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00090             double a2_slope = (next_a2 - a2) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00091             double b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00092             double b2_slope = (next_b2 - b2) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00093             
00094             while(filterLoops--)
00095             {
00096                 y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00097                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00098                 
00099                 y2 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y0 + b2 * y1; 
00100                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y2 + a1 * y0 + a2 * y1);
00101                 
00102                 y1 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y2 + b2 * y0; 
00103                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y1 + a1 * y2 + a2 * y0);
00104                 
00105                 a0 += a0_slope;
00106                 a1 += a1_slope;
00107                 a2 += a2_slope;
00108                 b1 += b1_slope;
00109                 b2 += b2_slope;
00110             }
00111             
00112             a0 = next_a0;
00113             a1 = next_a1;
00114             a2 = next_a2;
00115             b1 = next_b1;
00116             b2 = next_b2;
00117         }
00118         else // more cpu intensive but cleaner for rapid changes
00119         {       
00120             double freqSlope    = (newFreq - currentFreq) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00121             double controlSlope = (newControl - currentControl) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00122             double gainSlope    = (newGain - currentGain) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00123             
00124             while(filterLoops--)
00125             {
00126                 calculateCoeffs(currentFreq, currentControl, currentGain, a0, a1, a2, b1, b2);
00127                 
00128                 y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00129                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00130                 
00131                 y2 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y0 + b2 * y1; 
00132                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y2 + a1 * y0 + a2 * y1);
00133                 
00134                 y1 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y2 + b2 * y0; 
00135                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y1 + a1 * y2 + a2 * y0);
00136                 
00137                 currentFreq += freqSlope;
00138                 currentControl += controlSlope;
00139                 currentGain += gainSlope;
00140             }
00141             
00142             calculateCoeffs(newFreq, newControl, newGain, a0, a1, a2, b1, b2);
00143         }
00144         
00145         while(filterRemain--)
00146         {
00147             y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00148             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00149             
00150             y2 = y1; 
00151             y1 = y0;
00152         }
00153         
00154         currentFreq = newFreq;
00155         currentControl = newControl;
00156         currentGain = newGain;
00157         LOCAL_COPY(a0);
00158         LOCAL_COPY(a1);
00159         LOCAL_COPY(a2);
00160         LOCAL_COPY(b1);
00161         LOCAL_COPY(b2);
00162     }
00163     else
00164     {
00165         while(filterLoops--)
00166         {
00167             y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00168             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00169             
00170             y2 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y0 + b2 * y1; 
00171             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y2 + a1 * y0 + a2 * y1);
00172             
00173             y1 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y2 + b2 * y0; 
00174             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y1 + a1 * y2 + a2 * y0);
00175         }
00176         
00177         while(filterRemain--)
00178         {
00179             y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00180             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00181             
00182             y2 = y1; 
00183             y1 = y0;
00184         }
00185     }
00186     
00187     y1 = zap(y1);
00188     y2 = zap(y2);
00189     LOCAL_COPY(y1);
00190     LOCAL_COPY(y2);
00191 }

00296 void BLowPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain, 
00297                                            double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00298 {
00299     (void)gain; // not used in BLowPass
00300     
00301     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00302     double cosw0 = cos(w0); 
00303     double i = 1.0 - cosw0; 
00304     double alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (double)rq; 
00305     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha); 
00306     a0 = i * 0.5 * b0rz; 
00307     a1 = i * b0rz; 
00308     a2 = a0; 
00309     b1 = cosw0 * 2.0 * b0rz; 
00310     b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0rz; 
00311 }

00313 BLowPass::BLowPass(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq, UGen const& rq) throw()

00317     initInternal(numInputChannels);

00319     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00320     {
00321         internalUGens[i] = new BLowPassUGenInternal(input, freq, rq, false);
00322     }
00323 }

00408 void BBandPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float bw, const float gain, 
00409                                             double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00410 {
00411     (void)gain; // not used in BBandPass
00412     
00413     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00414     double sinw0 = sin(w0);
00415     double alpha = sinw0 * (sinh((0.34657359027997 * (double)bw * w0) / sinw0));
00416     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha); 
00417     a0 = alpha * b0rz; 
00418     a1 = 0.0;
00419     a2 = -a0; 
00420     b1 = cos(w0) * 2.0 * b0rz; 
00421     b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0rz; 
00422 }

00449 void BBandStopUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float bw, const float gain, 
00450                                             double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00451 {
00452     (void)gain; // not used in BBandStop
00453     
00454     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00455     double sinw0 = sin(w0);
00456     double alpha = sinw0 * (sinh((0.34657359027997 * (double)bw * w0) / sinw0));
00457     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);  
00458     b1 = 2.0 * b0rz * cos(w0); 
00459     a0 = b0rz; 
00460     a1 = -b1;
00461     a2 = b0rz; 
00462     b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0rz; 
00463 }

00491 void BPeakEQUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain, 
00492                                             double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00493 {   
00494     double a = pow(10., (double)gain * 0.025);
00495     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00496     double alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (double)rq;
00497     double alphaBy_a = alpha * a;
00498     double alphaOver_a = alpha / a;
00499     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alphaOver_a);    
00500     b1 = 2.0 * b0rz * cos(w0); 
00501     a0 = (1.0 + alphaBy_a) * b0rz; 
00502     a1 = -b1;
00503     a2 = (1.0 - alphaBy_a) * b0rz; 
00504     b2 = (1.0 - alphaOver_a) * -b0rz; 
00505 }

00519 BLowShelfUGenInternal::BLowShelfUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq, UGen const& rs, UGen const& gain, const bool faster) throw()

00533 void BLowShelfUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rs, const float gain, 
00534                                           double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00535 {   
00536     double a = pow(10., (double)gain * 0.025);
00537     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00538     double sinw0 = sin(w0);
00539     double cosw0 = cos(w0);
00540     double alpha = sinw0 * 0.5 * sqrt((a + (1.0/a)) * ((double)rs - 1.0) + 2.0);
00541     double aPlus1 = a + 1.0;
00542     double aMinus1 = a - 1.0;
00543     double i = aPlus1 * cosw0;
00544     double j = aMinus1 * cosw0;
00545     double k = 2.0 * sqrt(a) * alpha;
00546     double aPlus1Minusk = aPlus1 - k;
00547     double b0rz = 1.0 / (aPlus1 + j + k);   
00548     
00549     a0 = a * (aPlus1 - j + k) * b0rz;
00550     a1 = 2.0 * a * (aMinus1 - i) * b0rz;
00551     a2 = a * (aPlus1Minusk - j) * b0rz;
00552     b1 = 2.0 * (aMinus1 + i) * b0rz;
00553     b2 = (aPlus1Minusk + j) * -b0rz; 
00554 }

00584 {

00630 void BAllPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain, 
00631                                            double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00632 {
00633     (void)gain; // not used in BAllPass
00634     
00635     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00636     double alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (double)rq; 
00637     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);  
00638     b1 = 2.0 * b0rz * cos(w0); 
00639     a0 = (1.0 - alpha) * b0rz; 
00640     a1 = -b1;
00641     a2 = 1.0; 
00642     b2 = -a0; 
00643 }
